contexts.text: When (the most ancient people) perceived the morning they did not perceive the actual morning of the day, but the heavenly principle which is an image of the morning and the dawn in minds; hence the Lord is called the morning, the east, and the Day-spring.

In a state of peace, the celestial and spiritual things of the Lord are as in their dawn and spring, for peace is as the dawn in early morning, and as the spring in springtime; dawn and spring cause everything... to be full of joy and gladness; each thing derives an affection from the general nature of dawn and spring... AC 2780.
When he sees the dawn of day, he does not think about the dawn, but about the origin of all things from the Lord, and their advance into the day of wisdom.
The Lord's Church is compared to the times of the day; its first period to sun-rise, or to dawn and morning... AC 2905.

As the dawn ascended () = when the Lord's Kingdom draws nigh... Daybreak is here expressed by as the dawn ascended, and it = the time when the upright are separated from the evil... This time or state is called the dawn, because then the Lord comes, or, what is the same, His Kingdom then draws nigh. Such is really the case with the good, for there then beams forth with them an appearance of morning daybreak or dawn; hence, in the Word, the Lord's Advent is compared to the morning... as in Hosea: as the dawn is His going forth ()... His Advent, or drawing nigh, is here compared to the dawn. AC 2441.
The day of Jehovah cometh... as the dawn spread upon the mountains (): here, also, it treats of the Lord's Advent, and His Kingdom.
From the womb from the dawn () = the Lord Himself, thus the Divine love from which He fought.
In like manner, the fire upon the altar was to be kindled every dawn ().
In the supreme sense, morning and dawn = the Lord; in the internal sense, the Celestial of His love; hence also, a state of peace.
By the morning or dawn, when the dew descends, are signified states of innocence and peace.

After combats or temptations, man comes into this state (of peace), which is as the state of spring that follows autumn and winter, or as the state of dawn that follows evening and night: a state of peace in spiritual things is like one of spring and dawn in natural ones.

Until the ascending of the dawn () = before the conjunction of the natural good which is signified by Jacob with the Celestial Spiritual or the Divine good of truth. In the supreme sense, the dawn = the Lord; in the representative sense, His Kingdom; and in the universal sense, the Celestial of love; here, the Celestial Spiritual; for, when the dawn ascended, Jacob was named Israel, by which is signified the celestial spiritual man.

He said, Let me go, because the dawn ascendeth () = that temptation ceased when conjunction was at hand... The dawn = the conjunction of the natural good which is signified by Jacob with the Celestial Spiritual or the Divine good of truth. The reason the wrestling commenced before the dawn ascended, and ceased after it had ascended... is that the times of the day... signified states; here, states of conjunction through temptations, for when there takes place the conjunction of the internal man with the external, it is then dawn to him, because he then enters into a spiritual or celestial state; and then, too, if he is in such a state that he can perceive it there appears to him a light like that of the dawn: otherwise, his Intellectual is illuminated, and becomes to him as when one awakes from sleep in the early morning while the dawn is first enlightening and beginning the day.

Let me go, because the dawn ascendeth () = that the representative would depart from the descendants of Jacob before they came into the representatives of the Land of Canaan... Dawn = when they came into the Land of Canaan, thus into the representative of a Church there. Explained.
The dawn ascendeth = when conjunction is at hand, or is commencing.

Peace in Heaven is like spring on earth, or like the dawn, which do not affect by means of sensible varieties, but by means of a universal pleasantness flowing into each thing that is perceived, and which imbues with pleasantness not only the perception itself, but every single object. AC 8455.

This peace is like the morning or dawn in spring time: the night is past; all things of Earth live anew at the rising of the sun; the scent of vegetation is diffused by the descending dew of the skies; and the soft breath of spring gives fertility to the soil, and fills all minds with pleasantness. The reason is that the morning or dawn in the spring time corresponds to the state of peace of the Angels in Heaven.
How art thou fallen from heaven, Lucifer, son of the dawn ()... It is from this primeval state of (the first preachers of the Christian Church) that Lucifer is called the son of the dawn.
From the transparence of which comes the dawn and bloom of her life.
I fell into meditation respecting the fables of the ancients, that they feigned Aurora with wings of silver feathers, and in her face displaying the lustre of gold.

These two states (that is, reformation and regeneration) may be compared to the progression of light and heat in the days of the spring time; the first to daybreak or cock-crowing, the second to the morning and dawn.
This is the reason why the states of Spirits are varied, so that there may be compared to them the changes... of the day; dawn, noon, evening, night; and again dawn.
Lucifer is called the son of the dawn from the initiament of the light or of day; for the dawn = the Church at its beginning.
